name: demo-parallel
description: A four-layer DAG: three producers fan out, two aggregators join them, one merge collapses the pair, and a sentinel refuses to close unless every layer left evidence behind.

steps.label: alpha
steps.prompt: mkdir -p examples/.work/dag && printf 'alpha\n' > examples/.work/dag/alpha.txt && echo ALPHA_COMPLETE

grep_present.description: alpha must leave its own artifact behind

steps.label: beta
steps.prompt: mkdir -p examples/.work/dag && printf 'beta\n' > examples/.work/dag/beta.txt && echo BETA_COMPLETE

grep_present.description: beta must leave its own artifact behind

steps.label: gamma
steps.prompt: mkdir -p examples/.work/dag && printf 'gamma\n' > examples/.work/dag/gamma.txt && echo GAMMA_COMPLETE

grep_present.description: gamma must leave its own artifact behind

steps.label: pair-ab
steps.prompt: cat examples/.work/dag/alpha.txt examples/.work/dag/beta.txt > examples/.work/dag/pair-ab.txt && echo PAIR_AB_COMPLETE

steps.label: pair-bg
steps.prompt: cat examples/.work/dag/beta.txt examples/.work/dag/gamma.txt > examples/.work/dag/pair-bg.txt && echo PAIR_BG_COMPLETE

steps.label: merge
steps.prompt: sort -u examples/.work/dag/pair-ab.txt examples/.work/dag/pair-bg.txt > examples/.work/dag/merge.txt && echo MERGE_COMPLETE

grep_present.description: the merge must carry the alpha producer
the merge must carry the beta producer
the merge must carry the gamma producer
